title: Bank of England holds interest rates at 3.75% amid renewed inflation concerns
summary:
The Bank of England has held interest rates at 3.75%, offering some respite to mortgage borrowers after renewed geopolitical and inflationary pressures had raised concerns that borrowing costs could begin climbing again. The decision comes against an increasingly uncertain economic backdrop, with conflict in the Middle East contributing to higher and more volatile energy prices […]

title: Shawbrook funds £2.5m Bath listed building conversion
summary:
Shawbrook Bank has provided £2.5 million in development finance to APS Homes for the conversion of a Grade II listed former nursing home in Bath into seven residential apartments. The 18-month facility covers 100% of development costs for the 1857 building, with an estimated gross development value of approximately £5 million.

title: Lender completes £6.1m office refinance near Chancery Lane
summary:
MERA has completed a £6.1m equity release refinance on a serviced office building near Chancery Lane, London, enabling the owner to proceed with a separate commercial acquisition. The transaction was structured in partnership with mezzanine lender Martley Capital.

title: Durden & Hunt acquires Diggins & Co in Essex expansion
summary:
Durden & Hunt has acquired South Essex estate agency Diggins & Co, bringing the Rochford and Rayleigh-based firm into its growing network. The deal gives Durden & Hunt coverage across every Essex postcode.

title: UK house price growth slows to 1.4% amid pricing concerns
summary:
UK house price growth slowed to 1.4% in July, marking the third consecutive monthly deceleration, while London recorded its eleventh straight month of annual price falls at 3.3%, according to ONS data.

title: Estate agents warned against over-polished marketing
summary:
Estate agents pursuing perfection in their marketing may be undermining consumer trust, according to analysis of psychological research and recent consumer studies. Northwestern University research found that purchase likelihood peaks between 4.2 and 4.5 stars, rather than at five stars.

title: Davis Tate appoints new sales director for nine-branch network
summary:
Davis Tate has appointed Marc Williams as Sales Director to oversee its nine-branch network across Oxfordshire and Berkshire. Williams brings 27 years of estate agency experience, including management of multi-branch operations across London and the South of England.

title: Prime London sales activity hits lowest August since 2008
summary:
Prime London's property sales market recorded its weakest August performance in nearly two decades, with transactions falling to their lowest level since 2008, according to data from LonRes. The prime London data platform reported that average achieved sold prices fell 7% year-on-year in August, with values standing 6.7% below pre-pandemic levels.

title: England property listings surge 16% in early September
summary:
The number of properties listed for sale in England increased by 16% in the first two weeks of September, with more than 54,000 homes entering the market. Rutland recorded the largest regional increase at 35%, followed by the Isle of Wight at 34%.

title: Former CBRE UK chief joins proptech firm as adviser
summary:
Ciaran Bird, who led CBRE's UK & Ireland advisory business for over 12 years, has joined property technology firm LightWork AI as a strategic adviser. Bird will work with the company's founders on strategy development and building the leadership team.
